prerequisites: Owner saves and closes documents and confirms backups; Developer Mode must already be enabled. Enabling it is not authorized.
Owner verifies the cable SSH host key for root@10.11.99.1. No LAN runtime SSH is requested.
Resolve the existing desktop protocol-1 listener explicitly or use consistently configured distinct ports. Obtain trusted instructions from the real desktop service, not this deleted smoke identity.

actions.request: Approve one cable-connected SSH preflight to read model, architecture, firmware, recorded Xochitl hash, and XOVI/AppLoad/qt-resource-rebuilder version and file-hash metadata; inspect only named installation paths and launcher collisions. Stop if unsupported or dependency compatibility cannot be established.

After preflight and a final hash-pinned payload manifest are approved, run the generated installer once. Write only /home/root/.local/share/pi-ink-bridge and the named pi-annotations AppLoad and QMD links. Preserve all drafts, pairing records, unrelated extensions, and retained prototype files.

After the owner saves and closes documents, approve exactly one Xochitl restart, not an automatic reboot. Observe Pi Annotations sidebar launch and verified/offline connection states. Stop on failure; further restarts require new approval.

Approve repeating the same verified payload once and checking that launcher identity, pairing records, drafts, and unrelated files remain unchanged. No firmware, Developer Mode, firewall, cloud/account, pairing, or notebook changes are included.

limits: The tested package is host-built and not device-installed. No native AppLoad/XOVI version compatibility or post-restart launch is claimed.
